import numpy as np

def r(x):
    # Project x to the nearest discrete probability corresponding to integer success counts.
    # This preserves the value of round(100 * x), and thus the posterior mean.
    return round(100 * x) / 100.0

def R(y_orig, y_new):
    # The outputs must be exactly equal (within floating point tolerance).
    return np.abs(y_orig - y_new) <= 1e-6
